newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mostly lower.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat cash bids were mostly lower on Monday as MGE futures continued to sag and and farm sales were generally lackluster.
But high protein wheat activity remained active in the Dakotas, one Minneapolis dealer said.

"It seems that the 15 percent protein spring wheat price to the farmers out in the Dakotas is about $5.00 a bushel," the dealer said. He noted the farmer was beginning to sell high protein wheat. "At this time of the year, that is very good," he said.

MGE December wheat ended at $409-1.2 a bushel, down 3/4 cent. Also, the U.S. Department of Agriculture said that 63 percent of the winter wheat crop had emerged, compared to 44 percent a week ago and 60 percent five-year average.
